messages:
Alex S.: Hey team — AcmeCorp is hitting repeated card declines on invoice payments. Customer says they tried twice and the bank blocked 3DS popup. Our console shows PaymentIntent pi_1JqXyZ2eZvKYlo2C3abcdEF failed with "card_declined" and decline_code=insufficient_funds then another attempt returned authentication_required. They need this cleared today, customer is on a PO but wants to pay the outstanding balance while PO is processing.

Priya K.: Can you paste the invoice IDs and the payment attempts? Also is this EU-located customer (SCA applies)?

Alex S.: Invoice #INV-2025-0387 and INV-2025-0391. Customer region: FR (France) — SCA required. Attempts: first attempt returned decline_code=insufficient_funds, second attempt returned status=requires_action with last_payment_error.code = authentication_required. Copy of PaymentIntent payload below (sanitized):
```json
{
  "id": "pi_1JqXyZ2eZvKYlo2C3abcdEF",
  "amount": 125000,
  "currency": "eur",
  "status": "requires_action",
  "last_payment_error": { "type": "card_error", "code": "authentication_required", "message": "Issuer requires authentication" },
  "metadata": { "invoice_id": "INV-2025-0387" }
}
```

stripe-bot: PaymentIntent pi_1JqXyZ2eZvKYlo2C3abcdEF failed: card_declined (insufficient_funds) at 2025-11-15T09:12:10Z. Later attempt requires 3DS authentication.

Maria G.: Thanks. Two things: 1) if bank blocks the 3DS iframe/pop-up, we need customer to complete SCA via the hosted payment page (link) or try a different card; 2) since there's a PO, we can mark invoice as pending and process once PO arrives, but customer asked to attempt payment now. We should also check if our payment provider has any anti-fraud rules firing for AcmeCorp (high volume or BIN flags). @josh_eng can you check gateway logs for any fraud filters? :eyes:

Josh R.: On it. I'll pull the gateway logs and webhook traces for those PI IDs. Quick ask: did customer try the Stripe-hosted invoice link or our in-app collect flow? If in-app, the 3DS redirect may be blocked by their browser blockers.

Alex S.: They used the in-app flow via our billing modal embedded in an iframe inside their corporate network. They said a company-wide popup blocker seems to stop the 3DS page. Customer tried a second card and got the same auth_required. They can provide an alternate card or we can send a direct hosted invoice link.

Maria G.: Actionable next steps: 1) Alex — send hosted invoice link to customer and ask them to complete payment on a desktop browser with popups enabled or use mobile; 2) Josh — confirm if our checkout is set to use "redirect_to_url" fallback for SCA flows, and check for any firewall/iframe restrictions in iframe mode; 3) If anti-fraud is flagged, escalate to Stripe with PI id + logs and request review; 4) Tag finance to consider temporary credit hold if customer needs immediate access while PO processes.

Josh R.: I found webhook retries showing a 402 response from Stripe for first attempt and then a "requires_action" status returned. Our redirect fallback is enabled but not used in iframe mode — that's likely the blocker. I'll propose a small change: when status=requires_action, if embed=iframe then open a top-level redirect to Stripe's 3DS page. Need product sign-off though.

Priya K.: Customer is pressing for timeline. They requested we try a manual charge using stored card on file — is that allowed given SCA? If the card is not authenticated, manual charge will likely fail. Better to send hosted link.

Alex S.: Sent hosted invoice link to billing contact (acme-billing@acme.example) at 10:05 CET with instructions to allow popups or use mobile. Asked them to confirm after trying.

Maria G.: If hosted link fails, we'll open a support ticket with Stripe with this payload and request a fraud/manual review. Prepare: PI id, invoice ids, customer company reg/VAT (they provided FR VAT ID), exact timestamps, and a short reproduction note.

Alex S.: Will collect timestamps and customer screenshots. Customer also said their bank may be performing additional fraud checks — asked them to call their card issuer to whitelist the 3DS flow.

Josh R.: Filing an engineering note: regression risk low, but UX gap for iframe SCA flows. I'll draft a PR for a top-level redirect fallback and include feature flag.

stripe-bot: New note — escalate to payments-provider recommended when decline_code in [insufficient_funds, card_declined, authentication_required].

Maria G.: I'll queue a Stripe escalation if hosted link also fails. For now mark invoices as "pending payment attempts" to avoid automated dunning.

Priya K.: Customer responded: tried hosted link on laptop with popups enabled, payment completed after approving 3DS. They confirmed access to the feature. Closing the escalated ticket but leaving this thread for follow-ups on the iframe UX change. :white_check_mark:

Alex S.: Great — closing loop. Thanks everyone for quick help.
